holder-quote: His hand went to his side, to a little axe on his belt. He yanked it out. The Gargoyle’s back was open. Dawil lifted the small hatchet, felt it balance perfectly, and roared.
effect-quote: The axe spun through the skin on its back, through part of its spine, and stopped—halfway out of its chest.
His shield caught a charging [Assassin] on horseback. The figure went flying.
